title: "Clustering Stability"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import yaml
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import scanpy as sc
from utils.helpers import load_processed_data

with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

st_dict = load_processed_data(params)

# Preprocessing and clustering for each method
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    adata = st.sdata.tables["table"]
    adata.layers["counts"] = adata.X.copy()
    sc.pp.normalize_total(adata, inplace=True)
    sc.pp.log1p(adata)
    sc.pp.pca(adata)
    sc.pp.neighbors(adata)
    sc.tl.umap(adata)
    sc.tl.leiden(adata, flavor="igraph", n_iterations=2)
    print(f"{method}: clustering done")
```

## Overview

The clustering stability module evaluates how well the segmentation
produces internally consistent expression profiles. High clustering
stability suggests less transcript contamination between cells.

## UMAP visualization

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(st_dict), figsize=(6 * len(st_dict), 5))

if len(st_dict) == 1:
    axes = [axes]

for ax, (method, st) in zip(axes, st_dict.items()):
    adata = st.sdata.tables["table"]
    sc.pl.umap(
        adata,
        color="leiden",
        palette="Set2",
        ax=ax,
        show=False,
        title=method,
    )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Clustering stability metrics

```{python}
rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    ccd = st.cs.cluster_connectedness()
    sil = st.cs.silhouette_score()
    pur = st.cs.purity()
    ari = st.cs.adjusted_rand_index()

    rows.append({
        "Method": method,
        "Connectedness (↑)": round(ccd, 3),
        "Silhouette score (↑)": round(sil, 3),
        "Purity (↑)": round(pur, 3),
        "ARI (↑)": round(ari, 3),
    })

df_cs = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
df_cs
```

## Connectedness vs Silhouette score

```{python}
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

# Connectedness vs Silhouette
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_cs.reset_index(),
    x="Connectedness (↑)",
    y="Silhouette score (↑)",
    hue="Method",
    style="Method",
    s=150,
    palette="Set2",
    ax=axes[0]
)
axes[0].set_title("Connectedness vs Silhouette score")
axes[0].set_xlim(0, 1)
axes[0].set_ylim(-1, 1)
axes[0].axhline(0, color="grey", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)

# Purity vs ARI
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_cs.reset_index(),
    x="Purity (↑)",
    y="ARI (↑)",
    hue="Method",
    style="Method",
    s=150,
    palette="Set2",
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Purity vs ARI")
axes[1].set_xlim(0, 1)
axes[1].set_ylim(0, 1)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
